promotion.scope: Development selection only; not independent future validation

protocol.schema: Explicit99 replacement inputs; removes raw striking, finish/duration summaries, weight-pace interactions and sparse bout-sampled rank/P4P; retains experience, layoff, Elo, records, lagged weight, bios, grappling, reliable striking and dated weekly rank/opposition.
protocol.selection: Pooled2021–2023 log loss only, same predeclared V3 promotion gates; no requested matchup or2024 selection
protocol.splits: Train before preceding July1; calibrate July–December; score next calendar year
protocol.calibration: Mirrored fit, symmetric raw probabilities, then independent disjoint zero-intercept temperature calibration with logT in[-1.5,1.5]
protocol.blend: Fixed50:50 baseline and curated_monotonic_hgb raw probabilities, then own disjoint temperature

feature_generation.selection: Pooled 2021–2023 log loss only; unchanged V2 promotion gate against baseline_v2
feature_generation.splits: Train before preceding July1; calibrate July–December; score next calendar year
feature_generation.confirmation: 2024 is retrospective, already inspected; never used for selection
feature_generation.blend: Equal uncalibrated symmetric baseline/challenger probabilities, then independent disjoint temperature calibration
feature_generation.weekly_rank: Additive complete dated media board inputs, latest strictly before date; stale after35days; unknown distinct from verified absence. Live observation eligible only after retrieval, never backfilled into development.
feature_generation.ranked_opposition: Last5 strictly prior bouts; opponent rank frozen before that bout from dated boards only. Unknown ranks excluded. Strength=(16-rank)/16 with champion0/unranked16. Two-observation priors: strength.5,top5share0,ranked-opponent decisive winshare.5. Known-rank share=known/covered count,zero with no bouts. Draw/NC excluded from winshare denominator.

study.retrospective_scope: Previously inspected year; baseline and selected only after selection lock; never a selection input or untouched holdout.
study.event_bootstrap: 2000 paired event resamples, seed42; upper95 log-loss difference below zero
study.all_novice: Both athletes have at most3 prior covered bouts; diagnostic only
study.any_sparse: At least one athlete has at most3 prior covered bouts; diagnostic only
study.prior_count_policy: All canonical covered bouts strictly before event day; same-date observations excluded.
study.immutable_outputs: Never replace an existing different artifact or study report; use versioned output directories.

evaluation.kind: Previously inspected year; baseline and selected only after selection lock; never a selection input or untouched holdout.

warnings: 2024 is an already-inspected retrospective comparison, not an untouched holdout.
Weekly rankings are retrospectively reconstructed; live observations are never backfilled into history.
Sparse histories and unusual hypothetical matchups limit direct validation; no requested probability is a training target.
